[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Group the whole numbers and fractions separately:

(10 + 3 − 5 − 2) + (2/3 + 1/6 − 5/6 − 1/3)

Integer sum = 13 − 7 = 6

Fraction sum = (4/6 + 1/6 − 5/6 − 2/6) = −2/6 = −1/3

Final value = 6 − 1/3 = 5 2/3

**∴ The correct answer is 5 2/3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

Given expression: 10 2/3 + 3 1/6 − 5 5/6 − 2 1/3

Convert mixed fractions into improper fractions:

⇒ 10 2/3 = (10 × 3 + 2)/3 = 32/3

⇒ 3 1/6 = (3 × 6 + 1)/6 = 19/6

⇒ 5 5/6 = (5 × 6 + 5)/6 = 35/6

⇒ 2 1/3 = (2 × 3 + 1)/3 = 7/3

Substitute back into the expression:

⇒ (32/3) + (19/6) − (35/6) − (7/3)

Find the Least Common Multiple (LCM) of denominators 3 and 6, which is 6:

⇒ (64/6) + (19/6) − (35/6) − (14/6)

⇒ (64 + 19 − 35 − 14) / 6

⇒ (83 − 49) / 6

⇒ 34 / 6

⇒ 17 / 3

⇒ 5 2/3

**∴ The correct answer is 5 2/3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Mixed Fraction Conversion

A mixed fraction a b/c can be converted to an improper fraction using the formula: (a × c + b) / c.

BODMAS Rule

This rule dictates the order of operations: Brackets, Orders, Division, Multiplication, Addition, and Subtraction.

Like and Unlike Fractions

Fractions with the same denominator are like fractions; for unlike fractions, find the LCM of denominators to perform addition or subtraction.
